issue_context.title: XmlReader.BaseURI should be not nullable
issue_context.body:
Currently XmlReader.BaseURI in some exceptional situations (as found when applying nullable annotations) can return null, this seem to be due to bug in the code. BaseURI is documented as:

```
If there is no base URI for the nodes being returned (for example, they were parsed from an in-memory string), String.Empty is returned.
```

we should fix all corresponding TODO-NULLABLE when doing this work.
